description.en: Zhishu 2 is Guohua Intelligent's wheeled humanoid robot platform for indoor, level-floor environments. Its human-shaped upper body combines two articulated arms and dexterous hands with a height-adjustable column and wheeled base. The manufacturer positions it as an integrated mobile manipulation platform, with hardware for speech interaction, depth sensing, lidar mapping and arm control. It is offered as a configurable robot body and development platform; customer motion-control deployment and application integration are part of the intended use. The model has been publicly announced and exhibited, while current commercial delivery availability remains unverified.
